name: weapons-r2
note: The held weapons for the new weapon categories (docs/equipment-plan.md, owner 2026-11-13): a dagger and a spear (thrust, one-handed), a halberd (polearm: thrust, two-handed), a great axe and a war hammer (chop, two-handed). One candidate each. Cut to the weapon footprint with tools/art/weaponfit.js.

dagger.prompt: RENDERING REFERENCE: the attached farm man on magenta is an APPROVED character of this game, the attached OGRE holds a club painted the way this game paints weapons, and the attached LONG SWORD on magenta is this game's approved sword: match their rendering exactly (soft painterly, flat-ish colour with gentle shading, soft thick dark outlines, no texture, no background), and match the SWORD'S steel, brass and leather colours. SUBJECT: ONE DAGGER, a plain medieval fighting dagger, drawn as a game item for that farm man to hold. POINT UP, pommel down, symmetrical about its centre line. From the bottom: a small round brass pommel; a straight grip wrapped in dark brown leather, about as long as a fist is wide and a half; a short straight brass crossguard, about twice as wide as the blade; then a straight double-edged steel blade, broad at the guard and tapering evenly to a sharp point. The blade is only about TWICE as long as the grip: clearly a dagger, short and stout, not a sword. Colours: bright clean steel with one lighter and one darker side, warm brass, dark brown leather. Simple and bold: it is seen about 50 pixels tall on the board, so big plain shapes, no engraving, no jewels, no runes, no glow, no sparkle, no motion lines. COLOUR: never pink, never magenta, never purple anywhere on it. It stands perfectly UPRIGHT in the middle of the picture, exactly vertical, seen flat-on from the side: no tilt, no perspective, no foreshortening. It fills most of the picture's HEIGHT, with a margin of magenta above and below. ONE WEAPON ONLY, nothing else in the picture: no hand, no sheath, no shadow, no ground, no frame, no text. Every other pixel is pure solid magenta (#FF00FF).
